items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: And then I worked with him off and on with Jack Maheu’s Salt City Six.

ctx.x: So, but Linc Milliman had come to my high school because he had gone to Fredonia with Don Menza, who had gotten him on Maynard’s band, and he came here because he was a school friend of the choral director. And I met him. And then I worked with him off and on with Jack Maheu’s Salt City Six. And Randy did — now an English band becoming an American band again — half English, half American. Randy Jones was the drummer. And he was leaving. So the bass player, Rick Petrone, asked Linc if he knew any drummers. He…
